Full content visible, double tap to read brief content. This is the BEST thing I have ever bought from Amazon. Having always been interested in buying a SAD lamp I have been searching around for the best and most cost effective and this is it. Sunrise: The sunrise feature begins 30 minutes before your designated alarm time. This is great for me as I can sleep through moderate light and therefore it always manages to wake me up towards the end of the 30 mins. If you are a light sensitive sleeper then it may be too bright around 10-15 mins in. The alarm is easy to set up and change when needed and it’s clear when the alarm has been set as a small light appears on the side of the screen (which is useful!) The wake up sounds (at your alarm time) are not great. There is 5 to choose from, frogs, goats, cats and 2x birds. All of which are rather bad quality, especially the goats which are loud and quite scary. However, I find the bird options good enough and enjoy the natural feel of light and birds in the morning. Some reviews have said that you have to set your alarm every night however I have not found this to be the case. Often times the alarm is set for the following morning, however as stated above, it’s easy enough to check with the light on the screen. SUNSET: The sunset feature begins from whenever you press the sunset button. This for me is the most impactful feature as it makes you SO tired, even after the first fade around 5 minutes in. There has not been a single night since I bought this that I have witnessed the light go out as I always fall asleep before then. However, I can confirm the light does fade out fully. With the sunset feature you can also press the sunset button again to pause the sunset at the current light brightness. This is especially useful if you want a brighter light than the standard on/ off/ coloured setting. I love this lamp so much. The features are exactly what I needed it for and it has improved my sleep and morning routine so much! For the £23 I bought it for I'd say this is definitely not the worst investment I've ever made, and it absolutely does give me a far better tooth clean than any manual brush ever could. From that perspective it absolutely does what I bought it for. That being said though, I think I have to echo a lot of what other people have been saying about it, from the point of view of its downsides. I havent had quite the egregious battery life other people seem to have been experiencing, but I'd also hesitate to call the battery life "good". I live by myself, and I manage to get anywhere from two to three days out of it before it needs charging again. Its not absolutely terrible and I bought it knowing the battery life was a weak point, but if you have a full family thats using it then the battery won't last very long at all. This is a problem, considering that there's no way to know when the battery is getting low other than just how strong the motor feels when you're using it. Looking at the instructions, it seems like other models have an LED on them, but this one doesnt even have a single one. This both means that its hard to get an exact idea of when the battery needs charging, and also means you wont know when exactly its done charging either (I think maybe some people are experiencing poor battery life because they arent leaving it on for long enough, precisely because of that). You sort of just have to guess at when it might be done or check how strong the motor feels. Dont get me wrong, I like that its simple and I dont think its inherently a bad product - I intend to keep it an use it even with its flaws, just because it does everything I need it to, only really cost the equivalent of a few packets of toothburshes, and having the integrated timer is really useful. However I feel like they made it a little too simple for its own good. Not having even a single LED on there does kind of harm the functionality, given that the battery life isnt exactly stellar to begin with. I'm ok with that on balance since I'm the only one using it here, but it may well be worth it to most people to move slightly further up the like to a slightly higer end brush. I feel like its also worth noting, while we're on the subject, that the brush's charger only has a shaver plug connector, and it doesnt include an adapter for a standard wall socket. Thats fine if you have a shaver plug, but I feel like to an extent those are a dying breed so most people will also need a shaver plug adapter to use a normal socket with it, which is worth noting since it adds to the cost and it isnt really mentioned on the product page (albeit not especially significantly). Top reviews from the United Kingdom Jade 5 out of 5 stars The honest truth that hasn't been spoon fed to me by Tiktok Influencers Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 9 July 2026 Verified Purchase Brief content visible, double tap to read full content. Full content visible, double tap to read brief content. You've seen this on Tiktok, that's why you're here, probably trying to ensure you buy a genuine Medicube product rather than risking a fake. Good call. I also saw this on Tiktok, and was baffled by the blatant lies and exaggerations, which I believe is the reason this product has 4 stars. Tiktok calls it.. well I won't say what Tiktok calls it in case it gets my review declined, but let's just say they compare it to filler. If you're buying this product because you believe it's got the same ingredients as implants(?), it's so powerful that if you put it on your finger it'll swell up like a balloon, or you will see instant results, then please believe me when I tell you that firstly - you are Tiktok's ideal demographic, and secondly - you're gonna be disappointed in this product. If you're buying it because you've read about volufiline, but maybe don't want to jump straight to stronger forms of it, like the Ordinary serum for example, and you're willing to give the skincare a chance to actually work, you might just love this product. It is not 'vaseline in a stick', nor is it some miracle product that's gonna immediately rid you of your eye bags and crows feet. It is a dose of hydration around areas that need a little more attention as we age, and the ingredients do have some scientific backing behind them - with the caveat that the effects are subtle and are not a replacement for filler. Volufiline stimulates fat cells, causing the plumping effect that's so grossly misrepresented on Tiktok. I've been using for about a week every day, and I am noticing subtle differences in my under eye area, the shadows are lessening, and the delicate skin feels hydrated. Skincare girlies (and guys) know that skincare products need 6 weeks to be tested properly, so I'm excited that I can visibly see improvements in such a short period. I like the application, the product being in stick form means I can easily apply it quickly without worrying about wasted product, which can be an issue with the Ordinary serum - although the comparison isn't fair as the products are completely different in strength. The product is very gentle, and I have eczema, sporadic psoriasis and sensitive skin in general, this has caused no redness, irritation or stinging. Value wise, the price is likely up due to the product going viral, but I was pleased with the results so in my opinion the product is worth it, I would also advise (but you know, who am I to tell you what to do?) to buy the genuine Medicube balm, rather than the crop of 'dupes' that have sprung up trying to cash in on the hype. You and your skin, particularly your eyes, deserve quality ingredients, not a mish mash of cheap imitations smushed together and marketed as a dupe. As I haven't tested the product for long enough to make a fair assessment on the long term effects, what I will say is that at worst, it's a convenient, quality dose of hydration for areas that need it most, and at it's best I can see improvements in glow, skin quality and volume in the areas of my face that need a little top up. Remember - if something seems too good to be true, it usually is. I like the product, I like Medicube in general as a brand, and I would recommend this product based on what I've seen so far. I have been using the Shark FlexStyle Multistyler for several weeks now, and I can honestly say it has completely changed my hair styling routine. The first thing that impressed me was how lightweight and easy it is to use. I have fairly long hair, and traditional hair dryers and styling tools often leave my arms tired by the time I'm finished. The Shark FlexStyle feels comfortable to hold and the rotating design makes it incredibly versatile. The Auto-Wrap Curlers were the feature I was most excited about, and they did not disappoint. I was a little skeptical at first because I've struggled with curling my own hair using conventional curling wands. However, the FlexStyle automatically wraps sections of hair around the barrel using airflow, making the process surprisingly simple. After a few attempts, I was able to create beautiful, bouncy curls that looked like I had just come from a salon. The curls lasted most of the day, especially when I used a light styling spray. The Oval Brush attachment is another standout feature. It gives my hair a smooth, voluminous blowout look without needing to juggle a separate brush and hair dryer. My hair tends to become frizzy, particularly in humid weather, but this attachment helped create a sleek finish with noticeable volume at the roots. I also appreciated the Concentrator attachment for everyday drying. It directs airflow precisely where it's needed and helps achieve a polished look much faster than my previous hair dryer. One of the biggest advantages of the Shark FlexStyle is its promise of no heat damage. As someone who styles her hair several times a week, this was a major selling point. My hair feels noticeably softer and healthier compared to when I regularly used high-heat styling tools. The intelligent temperature control gives me peace of mind that I'm not exposing my hair to excessive heat. Another positive is the speed. Drying and styling my hair now takes significantly less time than before. What used to take nearly an hour can often be done in around 20 to 30 minutes, depending on the style I'm aiming for. There is a slight learning curve with the Auto-Wrap Curlers, especially if you've never used this type of styling technology before. The attachments can also take up a bit of storage space. However, once you become familiar with the different tools, the entire process becomes very intuitive. The build quality feels premium, and the attachments connect securely. It genuinely feels like a high-end styling system designed to replace multiple separate tools. Overall, I am extremely pleased with the Shark FlexStyle Multistyler. Das Schlafzimmer (25 Quadratmeter) verwandelte sich binnen eines Tages, bei Außentemperatur von -4c in einen Kühlschrank. Lieferung pünktlich. Direkt ausgepackt ungeduldig haben wir ihn direkt angeschlossen. Das Kabel ist lange genug um ihn mitten im Raum aufstellen zu können. Intuitiv haben wir auf den „on“ Knopf gedrückt. Über die + und - Tasten konnte man direkt die gewünschte Temperatur auswählen. Es kommt sofort heiße Luft raus. Es hat ein wenig gedauert, aber das kleine Teil hat es echt geschafft, dan Raum auf angenehme 24Grad Celcius ( wie eingestellt) zu bringen. Die Bedinung ist völlig intuitiv. Der Lüfter ist nun 2 Wochen im Einsatz. Er hat einen Timer, der im Stundentakt ( von 1h bis 12 h) eingestellt werden kann. Wenn man ihn ausschaltet, dann merkt er sich die zuletzt eingestellte Gradzahl, was super nützlich ist. Wir lassen ihn Abends und Morgens jeweils 6-7 Stunden, seid nun über zwei Wochen laufen. Man hört ihn auch kaum. Sei Geräuschbelastung ist echt quasi nicht vorhanden. Ja, natürlich hört man ihn „Luft pusten“, aber das ist mein Föhn 4x lauter… Er ist tatsächlich recht klein, daher haben wir ihn auf eine Kiste gestellt, damit die Luft mitten im Raum zirkulieren kann. …Eine Fernbedienung wird mitgeliefert. Besser geht nicht! Bester Kauf seit langem! Danke für die durchdachte Technik und das schöne Design! Preis ist auch unschlagbar. Read more Read less Report Sending feedback... Thank you. Product description Product Description Get the London Look! So you can do just that, from Rimmel London, comes 60 Seconds nail polish, Clear, a nail polish, that applies quickly and dries so fast you can change your look every day! This formula is chip resistant, anti fade, high shine and lasts up to 10 days and is perfect for a flawless professional like finish. So whether you're working, shopping, on a special occasion, or out with the girls your nails will have the look. Use the Xpress brush for simple, fast, even, 1 second application. 60 seconds Clear, is the perfect main stay of your nail colour collection or would be warmly received as a gift if you were looking to share your enjoyment of Rimmel London with others. Rimmel is the UK’s number 1 make-up brand and the face of London style. We live for the riot of colour on the streets, for the vibrant clubs and the hidden bars. We devour the music and the energy and come back for more. Rimmel believes in fashion without rules and values every individual interpretation of beauty. Rimmel’s extensive hot looks, cool prices range is kept bang up-to-the-minute as it translates the look of London into new shades, products, packaging and advertising. But however creative and fashion-forward, Rimmel products are always easy to use, versatile and accessible, designed to encourage experimentation and self-expression. Live the London look. Blocked nose, head cold, congestion, headache, fever, aches, and pain. How to relive symptoms of a cold? You can help relieve a blocked nose with Sudafed decongestant spray or tablets. You can ease aches and pains with painkillers like Paracetamol, or Ibuprofen. Sudafed capsule products contain paracetamol and a decongestant. How long does a cold last? It can vary, but you should begin to feel better in about a week or two. See your GP if your symptoms don't improve after 10 days. What is Sinusitis? A condition in which the cavities around the nasal passages become inflamed and swollen. Acute sinusitis can be triggered by a cold or allergies and may resolve on its own. What causes a blocked nose? A blocked nose occurs when the nose lining becomes inflamed and swollen. This causes the nasal passages to become narrower and therefore more easily blocked up. For the last few years, my washing machine had been giving off the most horrendous smell after each wash, which I can only describe as an ungodly mix of sewage, garlic, and egg. It was absolutely disgusting, and the smell would spread throughout the house. I tried every solution I could think of, including bicarbonate of soda, vinegar, hot cycles, and even other chemical cleaners, but nothing worked. I cleaned every part of the machine, replaced the pipes, scrubbed the detergent drawer, cleaned the drip tray, and ran hot washes, but the smell just wouldn't go away. I was at my wit's end, especially with guests coming to stay, and I couldn’t bear the thought of them waking up to that awful odour. So, I scoured Amazon one last time and came across this Dr. Beckmann Service-it Deep Clean Washing Machine Cleaner. Its bold claims of removing 99.99% of bacteria, fungi, and viruses, as well as eliminating bad odours, seemed too good to be true, so I had to try it! All I can say is wow! Using it couldn’t be easier. Just empty the whole 250g box into the drum, no measuring required, and set your machine to run at a minimum of 60°C for at least an hour. I opted for a 90°C wash, which lasts for 2 hours on my machine, for extra thoroughness. After just one wash, the disgusting smell that had plagued my home for years was completely gone, and three weeks later, it still hasn’t returned. I’m absolutely amazed at how effective this product is. It left no mess, no residue, and it feels like I have a brand-new washing machine. For the price, it’s unbeatable. I paid £2.90 for the 250g pack, which is enough for one full clean, and I’ve seen the price drop lower. Given how effective it is, that’s an absolute bargain! I’ve already ordered a few more packs to use regularly, as it’s recommended to use every 1-2 months to keep your machine in top shape. The cleaner is supposed to leave a lemon fresh scent, though I didn’t really notice that. But honestly, the fact that my machine no longer smells at all is a win for me. Now all I can smell is my laundry detergent, and that’s good enough! I’ve tried a lot of other products, including well-known brands like Dettol, but none of them were able to tackle the odour like this. It also worked wonders on the limescale build-up in my 20-year-old machine, leaving the drum and seals sparkling clean. This cleaner is suitable for both front-loading and top-loading machines, and it’s great for prolonging the life of your appliance by preventing limescale and dirt build-up. If you’ve been dealing with an awful odour in your washing machine like I was, I can’t recommend this product enough. I wish I had found it sooner. It would have saved me so much frustration. I’ll definitely be using it regularly from now on, and I’m excited to try more from the Dr. Beckmann range. If you’re looking for a product that truly works and is great value for money, this is it! Full content visible, double tap to read brief content. I’ve been really impressed with this Gorilla Super Glue. I originally bought it for a quick fix, but it’s turned into one of those essentials I keep reaching for. So far, I’ve used it to glue the sole back onto a pair of trainers, and it’s held up brilliantly even with regular use. I’ve also used it around the house to stick down some loose scotia beads covering the joints in my timber flooring, and it bonded them securely in no time. What stands out most is how fast it cures — you barely have to hold things in place for long before it sets. The mask has a cooling hydrogel texture that feels very comfortable on the skin. It stays in place surprisingly well and doesn’t slide around too much once applied. One of the most interesting features is that the pink gel gradually becomes more transparent as the essence is absorbed, which makes it easy to tell when it’s ready to remove. This colour-changing hydrogel design is one of the product’s signature features. After removing the mask, my skin felt well hydrated, smoother and looked noticeably brighter. It gave a healthy “glass skin” glow without feeling sticky or heavy. I also liked that it contains ingredients such as niacinamide and hydrolysed collagen alongside PDRN, making it feel like an intensive treatment rather than a basic sheet mask. Pros * Cooling and comfortable hydrogel texture * Leaves skin soft, plump and hydrated * Gives a healthy, radiant glow * Fits well and stays in place * Can be used overnight or for several hours during the day Cons * More expensive than standard sheet masks * Needs a few hours (or overnight) for the best experience, so it’s not ideal if you’re in a hurry * The fragrance may not suit everyone, especially if you’re very sensitive to scented skincare. Overall This feels like a luxurious treatment when my skin needs extra hydration before a special occasion or after a long week. While I wouldn’t use it every day because of the price, I’d happily repurchase it as part of a weekly skincare routine. Full content visible, double tap to read brief content. Dopo aver provato praticamente tutti i detergenti CeraVe, posso dire che questa è la versione che preferisco in assoluto per la mia pelle. Ho una pelle mista, quindi con alcune zone che tendono a lucidarsi e diventare più oleose e altre che invece possono risultare più secche. Per questo ho sempre cercato un detergente che riuscisse a pulire bene senza lasciarmi quella sensazione di pelle "tirata" dopo il lavaggio. Nel corso del tempo ho provato praticamente tutte le versioni della linea CeraVe. Ho iniziato anche dall'olio detergente, proprio perché cercavo qualcosa di estremamente delicato. Mi è piaciuto, soprattutto per la sensazione che lasciava e per la profumazione, ma personalmente non era quello con cui mi trovavo meglio. Ho poi provato la crema detergente e, invece, non sono riuscito ad apprezzarla particolarmente. Soprattutto in estate, la sensazione durante l'utilizzo mi risultava troppo simile a quella di spalmare una crema sul viso e non era la tipologia di detersione che cercavo. Con la Schiuma Detergente, invece, ho trovato finalmente il compromesso che cercavo. LA SCHIUMA FA DAVVERO LA DIFFERENZA La prima cosa che si nota è ovviamente la consistenza: a contatto con l'acqua il detergente produce una bella schiuma. Ora, dal punto di vista scientifico, più schiuma non significa necessariamente più pulizia. È un aspetto importante perché spesso associamo inconsciamente una grande quantità di schiuma a un prodotto più efficace. Però c'è anche un aspetto più pratico e personale: a me la schiuma piace. Durante la skincare trovo molto più piacevole massaggiare una schiuma sul viso rispetto a una crema o a un olio. È una piccola cosa, ma secondo me il fatto che una routine sia piacevole da fare aumenta anche la probabilità di riuscire a mantenerla con costanza. La skincare, alla fine, non è soltanto una questione di ingredienti: anche la sensorialità del prodotto conta nell'esperienza quotidiana. PERCHÉ È ADATTA ALLA PELLE MISTA La formula è pensata per detergere rimuovendo sebo, impurità e residui senza compromettere eccessivamente la barriera cutanea. CeraVe utilizza in questa linea ceramidi e acido ialuronico, ingredienti interessanti soprattutto perché la detersione non dovrebbe limitarsi a "sgrassare" la pelle, ma dovrebbe cercare di mantenere un buon equilibrio tra pulizia e comfort. Le ceramidi, in particolare, sono lipidi naturalmente presenti nella barriera cutanea e svolgono un ruolo importante nel mantenimento della funzione barriera. È quindi sensato trovarle all'interno di una linea cosmetica che punta a detergere senza lasciare la pelle inutilmente impoverita. Il detergente contiene inoltre niacinamide, ingrediente molto versatile che viene utilizzato frequentemente nelle formulazioni destinate alle pelli miste o impure. Una cosa che apprezzo è proprio il fatto che, dopo il risciacquo, non mi rimane quella sensazione di "pelle che tira" che personalmente associo a una detersione troppo aggressiva. COME LO UTILIZZO Ne basta davvero poco. Inumidisco il viso, erogo una piccola quantità di prodotto e lo massaggio delicatamente sulla pelle, senza sfregare eccessivamente. Poi risciacquo con acqua. Non vedo la necessità di utilizzare una quantità enorme di detergente: la schiuma si distribuisce bene e una confezione da 473 ml dura davvero a lungo. Ed è proprio questo uno dei motivi per cui considero questo formato particolarmente conveniente. 473 ML: UN FORMATO CHE FA LA DIFFERENZA Questa secondo me è una delle caratteristiche più sottovalutate. Molti detergenti che mi incuriosiscono, soprattutto alcuni prodotti coreani, vengono venduti in confezioni da 150, 200 o 250 ml. Non è necessariamente un problema, ma quando si utilizza un detergente ogni giorno, mattina e/o sera, il prodotto finisce abbastanza rapidamente. Qui invece abbiamo 473 ml, quindi quasi mezzo litro. Considerando che ne basta poco ad ogni utilizzo, una confezione mi dura veramente parecchio. Per una skincare quotidiana è un vantaggio enorme, soprattutto se si vuole evitare di ricomprare continuamente il detergente. LA MIA ESPERIENZA Dopo aver provato praticamente tutta la gamma detergente CeraVe, questa è quella che ricomprerei più volentieri. Non perché sia necessariamente "la migliore" per qualsiasi tipo di pelle, ma perché è quella che si adatta meglio alle mie esigenze. La mia pelle mista ha bisogno di una detersione che mi faccia sentire il viso pulito senza trasformare il lavaggio in un momento in cui la pelle viene aggredita. La schiuma rende inoltre l'utilizzo molto piacevole e il formato da 473 ml permette di utilizzarlo quotidianamente senza preoccuparsi troppo dei consumi. PRO: ✅ Ottimo compromesso per pelle mista. ✅ Schiuma piacevole e facile da distribuire. ✅ Non lascia, nel mio caso, una sensazione eccessiva di pelle che tira. ✅ Formula con ceramidi, acido ialuronico e niacinamide. ✅ 473 ml: formato molto più conveniente rispetto a molti detergenti più piccoli. ✅ Ne basta poco e quindi dura davvero tanto. VALUTAZIONE FINALE Dopo aver provato praticamente tutti i detergenti CeraVe, questa è la versione che sceglierei nuovamente. Full content visible, double tap to read brief content. 3/5 stars A Promising Blend with a Misleading Punch I was genuinely excited to try this Magnesium complex. The 3-in-1 blend of Glycinate, Citrate, and Malate seemed like a brilliant idea, combining the best of all worlds for relaxation, regularity, and energy. At first, the effects were noticeable. The Glycinate seemed to help with sleep, and the Citrate gave a gentle nudge to my digestive system without the usual urgency of other brands. The Malate component felt like it was contributing to a slight increase in my afternoon focus. However, my enthusiasm waned when I took a closer look at the label. The "1800mg" in the product title is a clever, but ultimately misleading, headline. A quick calculation reveals that the actual elemental magnesium is only 384mg per serving. While 384mg is a solid dose and within the recommended daily intake for most people, it's not the massive 1800mg the title suggests. The 1800mg figure refers to the total weight of the three magnesium compounds before the magnesium is separated from its bonded molecule (glycine, citric acid, malic acid). This kind of marketing is common in the supplement world, but it feels particularly deceptive here. Furthermore, the capsules themselves are quite large. For someone who has trouble swallowing pills, this could be a major drawback. I also noticed that the blend, while well-intentioned, didn't seem to deliver the full punch of a pure Magnesium Glycinate supplement when it came to deep relaxation. It felt more like a jack-of-all-trades, master-of-none situation. In conclusion, this is not a bad product. The quality seems good, and the combination of forms is a unique selling point. However, the misleading marketing and the slightly muted effects for specific goals (like deep sleep) prevent me from giving it a higher score. If you're looking for a general magnesium supplement and are aware of the actual elemental dosage, this could be a decent option. But if you're seeking a specific benefit and are sensitive to marketing claims, you might want to look elsewhere. Read more Read less 1,604 people found this helpful Helpful Sending feedback... " Read more View Image Gallery Amazon Customer 5.0 out of 5 stars Images in this review Reviews with images See all photos Previous slide Next slide All photos Amazon Customer 5 out of 5 stars Comfortable, True-to-Size Gloves That Don't Tear Easily I've tried quite a few disposable gloves over the years for various jobs, including DIY, maintenance work, and more 3D resin printing, and these have impressed me more than expected. Sizing is often an issue with disposable gloves, as many of the cheaper ones I've bought in the past tend to come up smaller than advertised. An XL can sometimes fit more like a Large. Thankfully, these are true to size. The XL fits me perfectly, with no tight spots and no excess material at the fingertips, making them comfortable to wear while still allowing good dexterity. The gloves strike a nice balance in thickness. They're not the thickest nitrile gloves I've used, but they're certainly not flimsy or paper-thin either. They provide a reassuring level of protection while still allowing enough finger sensitivity for detailed tasks. One thing I particularly like is how much stretch they have. They slide on easily and stretch well without immediately tearing, which is something I've experienced with cheaper gloves in the past. My main use for these has been 3D resin printing, where reliable hand protection is essential. During several printing sessions, I had no issues with resin penetrating the gloves, and they held up well while handling resin-coated parts. They gave me confidence that my hands were properly protected throughout the process. Being powder-free and latex-free is another plus, especially for anyone with latex sensitivities or who simply prefers gloves that don't leave residue behind. They're comfortable enough to wear for extended periods and don't have an overpowering chemical smell when first opened. Considering the fit, durability, comfort, and level of protection they provide, I think these offer excellent value for money. They perform exactly as I'd hoped and compare favourably with gloves that cost considerably more. Once this box is finished, I'll happily buy another. If you are a camper or just someone who uses these single-burner stoves for a quick brew or a BBQ, these are an easy recommendation. The contents slide out of the sachets into the bowl, meaning you don't have to squash it out with your hands. The pieces of food look meatier than any other cat food brand, and there's just a fine layer of jelly. In the past, I've found my cats would eat the jelly and leave the meat. With these Felix sachets, they lick the dish clean. Each sachet holds the perfect amount to feed my three cats two sachets each a day. They have dried food too as they like a variety. Unlike other brands, there's barely any smell from this food. When I've put the food down at night and the cats go out without eating it, it doesn't dry up. They'll happily eat it when they come back in the morning. I rehomed a black cat whose fur was far from soft, but several months of eating Felix cat food shed got a lovely soft coat. None of my cats have ever been sick after eating Felix, unlike other food sachets which they were constantly throwing up. So it's obviously good for their digestion. One of my cats gets up onto my workbench and sits, staring at the cupboard. I keep the food in and won't budge until he's fed. That's him in the photo waiting on his food. I usually feed him separately as the two girls tend to budge in and eat his food too. My cats love it. They lick their dishes clean, and they'd definitely recommend it.
